entries.title: Early exhibition in Patna
entries.summary: Sources describe the Elphinstone Theatre in Patna becoming the Elphinstone Cinema and screening silent films.

entries.title: Sound cinema arrives in Patna
entries.summary: Secondary histories place the opening of Patna's first sound theatre in the early 1930s.

entries.title: Magadhi cinema
entries.summary: Bihar Foundation identifies Bhaiyaa as the first Magadhi film.

entries.title: Bhojpuri cinema begins
entries.summary: Bihar Foundation identifies Ganga Maiyya Tohe Piyari Chadhaibo as the landmark beginning of Bhojpuri-language cinema.

entries.title: Lagi Nahin Chute Ram
entries.summary: Bihar Foundation describes the film as a historic Bhojpuri hit.

entries.title: Maithili cinema
entries.summary: Kanyadan is widely identified as the first Maithili feature, but sources differ on production and release chronology.

entries.title: Bhojpuri revival
entries.summary: Secondary histories identify Saiyyan Hamar as part of the industry's early-2000s revival.

entries.title: Mithila Makhaan
entries.summary: Bihar Foundation records Mithila Makhaan's National Film Award recognition.

entries.title: Gamak Ghar at MAMI
entries.summary: Secondary histories record Gamak Ghar's premiere at the Jio MAMI Mumbai Film Festival.

entries.title: Bihar Film Promotion Policy
entries.summary: The state published the Bihar Film Promotion Policy 2024 to support production, infrastructure, employment and tourism.
